## Behavior and acceptance
Given the isolated account, when tracking costs, then account-wide reporting and service/project/job attribution expose compute, storage, transfer, and coordination costs. Budget/anomaly notifications supplement operational controls; delayed billing alerts are not a hard real-time cap. Test the operator kill switch, stalled jobs, duplicate submissions, retry storms, and spend-triggered admission shutdown before production enablement. Include a staged migration and inventory/retirement plan for old Babulus rendering resources to prevent double billing.

## Ownership
Babulus infrastructure; dedicated Babulus/VideoML AWS member account

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
